fact: On 7 September 2026 the Fédération générale de l'enseignement secondaire called on school staff to boycott the Ministry of Education's new digital platform, saying it was still in an experimentation phase and reporting disruptions to enrolments, pupil transfers, automatic assignment and the pedagogical timetable in its establishments; the article does not name the platform.
title: À l'approche de la rentrée, la nouvelle plateforme du ministère dysfonctionne : les enseignants appellent au boycott
